interface.name: org.helix_editor.Helix1
interface.tp:docstring: Lets other processes ask this Helix instance to open a file.

method.name: OpenFile
method.tp:docstring: Opens a file, optionally moving the cursor to a given position and/or switching the current view to show it.

arg.name: path
arg.tp:docstring: Absolute path of the file to open.

arg.name: line
arg.tp:docstring: 1-indexed line to move the cursor to, or 0 to leave the cursor's line untouched.

arg.name: column
arg.tp:docstring: 1-indexed column to move the cursor to, or 0 to leave the cursor's column untouched.

arg.name: focus
arg.tp:docstring: If true, switch the current view to show the file immediately. If false, only load it in the background, e.g. for a `git commit` editor hook that shouldn't steal focus from whatever the user is already looking at.

arg.name: wait
arg.tp:docstring: If true, don't reply until the file's buffer is closed in Helix (e.g. with `:bclose`) or the instance exits. This lets Helix be used as a blocking `$EDITOR`, e.g. for `git commit` or `crontab -e`. There is no timeout: the call blocks for as long as the buffer stays open, so callers should use a connection with no method-call timeout.

arg.name: error
arg.tp:docstring: Empty on success, or a human readable error message on failure.

method.name: ListOpenFiles
method.tp:docstring: Lists the absolute paths of this instance's currently open buffers that are backed by a file on disk (unsaved scratch buffers with no path are omitted).

arg.name: paths
arg.tp:docstring: Absolute paths of the open buffers.

arg.name: path
arg.tp:docstring: Absolute path of the open file to close.

arg.name: force
arg.tp:docstring: If true, discard unsaved changes instead of failing when the buffer is modified.

arg.name: error
arg.tp:docstring: Empty on success, or a human readable error message on failure.

method.name: ReloadFile
method.tp:docstring: Reloads a file's buffer from disk. Its content is replaced with a diff against the file's current on-disk content and applied as a single edit, so unsaved changes are overwritten but still recoverable with undo.

arg.name: path
arg.tp:docstring: Absolute path of the open file to reload.

arg.name: error
arg.tp:docstring: Empty on success, or a human readable error message on failure (e.g. the file isn't open, or no longer exists on disk).

method.name: GetCursorPosition
method.tp:docstring: Reports the primary cursor's position in an open file's buffer.

arg.name: path
arg.tp:docstring: Absolute path of the open file.

arg.name: line
arg.tp:docstring: 1-indexed line. 0 on failure.

arg.name: column
arg.tp:docstring: 1-indexed column. 0 on failure.

arg.name: error
arg.tp:docstring: Empty on success, or a human readable error message on failure (e.g. the file isn't open).

method.name: GetSelection
method.tp:docstring: Reports the primary selection in an open file's buffer: the range it covers and the text within it. Helix models even a plain cursor (nothing deliberately selected) as a one-character-wide selection over the character under the cursor, so `text` is never empty in a non-empty file.

arg.name: path
arg.tp:docstring: Absolute path of the open file.

arg.name: start_line
arg.tp:docstring: 1-indexed start line. 0 on failure.

arg.name: start_column
arg.tp:docstring: 1-indexed start column. 0 on failure.

arg.name: end_line
arg.tp:docstring: 1-indexed end line (inclusive side may extend one past the last selected character). 0 on failure.

arg.name: end_column
arg.tp:docstring: 1-indexed end column. 0 on failure.

arg.name: text
arg.tp:docstring: The text the selection covers.

arg.name: error
arg.tp:docstring: Empty on success, or a human readable error message on failure (e.g. the file isn't open).

method.name: GetDiagnostics
method.tp:docstring: Lists an open file's current diagnostics (e.g. LSP errors and warnings).

arg.name: path
arg.tp:docstring: Absolute path of the open file.

arg.name: diagnostics
arg.tp:docstring: One entry per diagnostic: 1-indexed (start_line, start_column, end_line, end_column), then severity ("error", "warning", "info", or "hint"), then the diagnostic's message.

arg.name: error
arg.tp:docstring: Empty on success, or a human readable error message on failure (e.g. the file isn't open).

method.name: GetWorkspaceRoot
method.tp:docstring: Reports a workspace root: the nearest ancestor directory of `path` containing a `.git`, `.svn`, `.jj`, or `.helix`, falling back to this instance's own working-directory-derived workspace if none is found (or if `path` is empty). `path` need not be open, or even exist; this never actually fails, the `error` output exists only for consistency with the rest of this interface.

arg.name: path
arg.tp:docstring: Absolute path to resolve a workspace for, or empty for this instance's own workspace.

arg.name: root
arg.tp:docstring: Absolute path to the workspace root.
